settings.heading: Gifts with character. For men with taste.

settings.text:
Looking for the perfect Christmas gift for a man with taste?

O'Donnell Moonshine has something for everyone: from handmade liqueurs made from the best ingredients, such as our Hard Nut with its full-bodied hazelnut flavour or Plump Cherry with its intense fruitiness, to our powerful premium spirits. For all those who like it stronger, we have our classic vodka with 40% and for real connoisseurs the High Proof with a strong character of 50% in our programme. All our exceptional spirits come in a stylish mason jar - a gift that is guaranteed to be remembered. Because special men deserve special gifts.
